baseline.definition: Exact research/export/brake_artifact.py recipe refit per fold on outer-train only: ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=200, max_depth=4, min_samples_leaf=20, max_features=1.0, criterion='squared_error', bootstrap=False, n_jobs=1, random_state=20260816); target=scores[:,2]-scores[:,1]; sample_weight=min(generations[:,1],generations[:,2]); features=ossp_router.cost_calibrated_router.structural_features/14.
baseline.name: uplift-xtrees-refit

primary.definition: Same fitted forest as baseline; rank key is predicted_delta_k / max(safe_increment_k_minus_a, 1e-12) where safe_increment uses the frozen premium safe costs row[2]-row[1]. Eligibility, brake_ratio, count_cap, denylist and runaway constants are unchanged.
primary.name: density-xtrees-refit

secondary_evidence_only.definition: Weighted closed-form ridge alpha=100 on standardized 14-d structural features (outer-train mean/std), intercept column unpenalized, weights=min(generations ax31, generations k1), target=scores[:,2]-scores[:,1], ranked by density like primary. Reported for evidence; selection_use=none under this protocol.
secondary_evidence_only.name: density-ridge-standardized-wls

context_frozen.note: Cost heads, ladder caps, family guard multipliers and every brake constant stay shipped/frozen. Only the promotion rank key varies between arms.

decision_reasons.fail: Primary arm failed a pre-registered gate on fresh seeds. Keep the current runtime.
decision_reasons.pass: Runtime-in-the-loop grouped OOF passed all gates on fresh seeds. This opens the promotion window only; integration requires a separate sealed protocol with full-public refit.

epsilon_formula: 0.5 * sum_f abs(p_train_f - p_dev_f) from materialized inputs family counts only

equivalence_gate.definition: Composed path (shared parent via feasibility_ladder._select_premium_configured plus budget_brake_router.promote_premium_brake with an injected shipped-quality vector) must reproduce budget_brake_router.make_submission premium decisions byte-identically on the full Train 1760 replay.

metric.definition: Paired Premium-tier official score difference (arm minus baseline) on held-out fold episodes pooled per seed; scores are public outcomes of the chosen model only.
metric.protocol_note: Unlike E1-E1F this evaluates through the actual serving allocator replica, not exact-cost oracles. The frozen-runtime fidelity failure showed exact-cost-selected heads do not transfer to the brake allocator.

motivation.root_cause: record-chuf-frozen-runtime-fidelity-fail-current-runtime showed heads selected against exact-cost OOF allocators do not transfer to the frozen brake allocator (realized delta-K 0.517/0.5625 versus CHUF assumed 0.2709/0.3099). E5 therefore selects the ranking key inside the serving allocator itself.

runtime_in_the_loop.parent_allocation: Once per fold batch, shared across arms, from the shipped artifact only.
runtime_in_the_loop.promotions: budget_brake_router.promote_premium_brake called directly per arm with an injected quality vector; the sort key inside the function is (-quality, digest) so the density key is applied by transforming the vector before injection.
runtime_in_the_loop.scoring: Public outcomes only, after decisions are frozen.

seed_derivation.algorithm: digest_i = SHA256(UTF8(PREFIX) + NUL + bytes.fromhex(CORE) + i.to_bytes(4,'big')); seed_i = int.from_bytes(digest_i[:4],'big') & 0x7fffffff; i=0..4. Collision with any previously used seed fails closed.

stress_views.definition: Per seed, one batch per prompt_family containing every episode of that family (each episode uses its own fold's fitted head). Allocator runs end-to-end per batch per arm.
stress_views.purpose: Family-homogeneous composition shift; the actual-ratio gate applies to every batch.

tv_ball.radius_source: materialized inputs family counts only; identical to chuf-tvball-confirmation-v1
